name: Lightning-NeRF Rendering and Training Loop
definition: A neural rendering method that uses a hybrid density representation (voxel grid + hash encoding) and a view-independent/view-dependent MLP decomposition, with adaptive sampling warmup and occupancy grid updates for efficient training and inference.
summary: Lightning-NeRF accelerates neural rendering by combining hybrid density representations with adaptive sampling and dynamic occupancy grid updates to efficiently train on large-scale scenes.
